caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical or cast iron toy consisting of a man and a mule mounted on a rectangular base. The base is predominantly red with green edges and has some text and detailing on its surface. The mule, colored in shades of brown with black and red harnesses, is shown kicking up its hind legs, with its front legs on the base and its head down. The man, dressed in a blue uniform with a yellowish-brown shirt and black boots, appears to have been bucked off, lying on his back with his legs up in the air and a whip or stick in his right hand. The drawing includes detailed shading and highlights to give the objects a three-dimensional appearance, and the background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "CHRIS HAMRKEN," appears below the base of the toy.
title: Toy Bank: Figure with Mule
